hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/block-secrets-edit.js" ]; then node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/block-secrets-edit.js"; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ] || [ $rc -eq 2 ]; then exit $rc; fi; echo 'block-secrets-edit hook crashed (exit '$rc'); blocking' >&2; exit 2; else echo 'block-secrets-edit hook missing; blocking' >&2; exit 2; fi
